value.title: PA presence nudges and large-seat notes
value.summary: Pure trackers in crates/core, wired into the existing PA watchdog round; stored once-per-stretch claims; Copilot context size; docs.

value.title: Pure trackers: fleet active, PA missing, dormant, unresponsive, large seat
value.success: State machines beside IdleEdge and PrimeActive in crates/core/src/watchdog.rs, with the four thresholds as named constants, and unit tests for every arm, re-arm and cap.

value.title: Wire them into the PA watchdog round, with stored claims
value.success: pa_watchdog.rs runs the trackers per scope each round, including scopes with no live PA; messages go through the ordinary delivery path (FYIs held, never a wake); claims stored before sending; audited on watchdog.round; private-daemon tests over simulated rounds and a restart.

value.title: Copilot seats report context size
value.success: The Copilot extension sends contextUsedTokens with a known basis from what it already sees; no new launch; pij list and the PA digest show it.

value.title: Cost receipts
value.success: Spawn counters equal with the checks on and off on a private daemon; live readings before and after deploy recorded in the PR.

value.title: Docs
value.success: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md and the PA and prime sections of skills/pij describe the four messages, thresholds and responses; the PR body has a Delivers: line.
